content:
anna: Quick sync: I sketched a tiny flow for 'inspect samples' in Console
goal is low-friction debugging without widening PII blast radius.

kai: high level?

anna: per-route sampling config + small redaction-confidence chip. Two sample tags: DEBUG (ephemeral, Console-only) and AUDIT (rare, strict access).

ravi: default rates? we need sane defaults to avoid cost surprises.

anna: thinking defaults: debug=0.01% (1e-4), audit=0.0005% (5e-6). Allow per-route and tenant overrides but enforce org caps.

dana: attachments / embeddings should be opt-out by default. If a route has file uploads or embedding outputs, sampling disabled unless tenant explicitly opts in with documented justification.

policy-bot: auto-policy: /v1/attachments flagged sensitivity=0.95 -> auto-opt-out.

kai: UI notes: show "sampling: 0.01% debug / 0.0005% audit" next to route, small info icon explaining what's included. For redaction-confidence, prefer banded levels (low/med/high) + reason pill ("email", "ssn-like"). Avoid showing raw floats.

ravi: security: viewing a DEBUG sample must require breakglass justification and create an immutable audit entry (actor, reason, timestamp). DEBUG views expire after 24h. AUDIT access uses RBAC + retention policy.

anna: infra: we need an immediate org-level kill-switch and a per-tenant enforcement hierarchy. Kill-switch sets all debug rates to 0 and shows a banner in Console.

dana: cost estimate: Console should preview projected token cost when changing slider: recent request volume * avg tokens * sampling_rate. Also warn if estimated monthly cost > org budget.

kai: edge-case: what if redaction model flags low confidence but scrub removed sensitive text incorrectly? Add periodic regression checks: sample diffs fed into Optimize evals and alert if false negatives or over-scrub spikes.

ravi: propose small config snippet for infra/product alignment:

```yaml
route: /v1/chat/complete
sampling:
  debug_rate: 0.0001   # 0.01% Console-visible, TTL 24h
  audit_rate: 0.000005 # 0.0005% stored in audit with restricted access
redaction:
  strategy: mask-first
  display_confidence: banded
  attachments: auto_opt_out
```

anna: next steps: I'll open a short RFC and prototype the Console badge + slider. owner: @kai for UI, @ravi for infra kill-switch + audit trail. Dana add compliance notes on opt-in flow for attachments.

dana: will add compliance checklist and tenant opt-in template.

kai: will mock the badge and the cost preview.

anna: thanks all 440 will post RFC link here when ready.
